plain: A neutral person who helps two sides reach agreement

webster.text: One that interposes between parties at variance for the purpose of reconciling them.

example.quote: To avoid these dangers, let a distinct assembly be constituted, as a mediator between the two extreme branches of the legislature, that which represents the people, and that which is vested with the executive power.
example.cite: John Adams, Thoughts on Government, Applicable to the Present State of the American Colonies (Philadelphia 1776)
